blocks.zh: 測試矩陣與試驗程序 — 從環境測試到 EMC 驗證
blocks.en: Test Matrix and Test Procedures — From Environmental Testing to EMC Verification

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 Table 3 測試矩陣結構：了解哪些測試適用於哪些 System Designation，以及各測試的樣本數（Y）和統計要求
blocks.en: Understand the structure of the Table 3 test matrix: which tests apply to which System Designation, and the sample size (Y) and statistical requirements of each test

blocks.zh: 理解「預處理（Pre-conditioning）+ 劑量準確性測試」的測試邏輯——測試設備的韌性
blocks.en: Understand the logic of "pre-conditioning + dose accuracy testing": testing the robustness of the device

blocks.zh: 能夠評估 D1 autoinjector 設計驗證報告中所需的測試項目完整性
blocks.en: Be able to assess whether the test items required in a D1 autoinjector design verification report are complete

blocks.zh: 了解 EMC 要求對含電子元件 NIS（如電動 pen injector）的影響
blocks.en: Understand how EMC requirements affect NIS containing electronic components (such as electronic pen injectors)

blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 測試矩陣的核心邏輯：「壓力 + 劑量準確性」
blocks.en: Core Logic of the Test Matrix: "Stress + Dose Accuracy"

blocks.zh: Table 3 中大多數測試都遵循同一個邏輯：
blocks.en: Most tests in Table 3 follow the same logic:

blocks.zh: 施加環境壓力（Pre-conditioning）→ 恢復到標準條件 → 測量劑量準確性
blocks.en: Apply environmental stress (pre-conditioning) → return to standard conditions → measure dose accuracy

blocks.zh: 這個設計背後的問題是：「NIS 在各種現實環境條件（冷藏、熱帶氣候、墜落、運輸振動）後，是否仍能準確遞送藥物？」
blocks.en: The question behind this design is: "Can the NIS still deliver the drug accurately after real-world environmental conditions (refrigeration, tropical climate, drops, transport vibration)?"

blocks.zh: 特別值得注意的是溫度測試（10.2）：在5°C（冷藏後立即使用）和40°C（高溫環境）下分別測試，直接對應患者的實際使用場景。
blocks.en: Of particular note is the temperature test (10.2): testing at 5°C (use immediately after refrigeration) and at 40°C (hot environment) corresponds directly to actual patient use scenarios.

blocks.zh: D1 Autoinjector 的必測項目
blocks.en: Required Tests for a D1 Autoinjector

blocks.zh: Designation D1（最常見的 autoinjector）在 Table 3 中需完成的測試：
blocks.en: Tests that Designation D1 (the most common autoinjector) must complete under Table 3:

blocks.zh: ✅ 溫度測試（Cool/Standard/Warm）：60 支，p=0.975
blocks.en: ✅ Temperature test (Cool/Standard/Warm): 60 units, p=0.975

blocks.zh: ✅ 自由跌落：21 支（C/D 版本），p=0.95
blocks.en: ✅ Free fall: 21 units (C/D versions), p=0.95
✅ Dry heat/cold storage: 60 units, p=0.975
✅ Vibration test: 20 units, p=0.95

blocks.zh: ❌ 最後劑量測試（Last-dose）：僅 A/C 系統（多劑量）
blocks.en: ❌ Last-dose test: A/C systems only (multi-dose)

blocks.zh: ❌ 壽命週期測試（Life-cycle）：僅 A/B 系統（可替換容器）
blocks.en: ❌ Life-cycle test: A/B systems only (replaceable container)

blocks.zh: ❌ 潮濕熱/循環測試：僅 A/B 系統
blocks.en: ❌ Damp heat/cycling test: A/B systems only

blocks.zh: EMC：僅含電子元件時
blocks.en: EMC: only when electronic components are present

blocks.zh: 完整 D1 DV 計劃需要的 NIS 數量：最多 ~200 支（各測試的 20-60 支加上備品）。
blocks.en: Number of NIS needed for a complete D1 DV plan: up to ~200 units (20-60 units per test, plus spares).

blocks.zh: 自由跌落測試的現實意義
blocks.en: Practical Significance of the Free Fall Test

blocks.zh: 1 m 的跌落高度並非隨意設定：大約是成人坐著時手持注射器到地面的高度。這代表了「患者不小心把注射器從手中掉落」的最常見場景。
blocks.en: The 1 m drop height is not arbitrary: it is roughly the height from the hand of a seated adult holding an injector to the floor. It represents the most common scenario of "a patient accidentally dropping the injector from the hand."

blocks.zh: 3 個方向（前/後、左/右、頂/底）確保測試覆蓋最脆弱的衝擊方向。
blocks.en: The 3 orientations (front/back, left/right, top/bottom) ensure that the test covers the most vulnerable impact directions.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO：若客戶更改了 PFS 的初級包材（如從 BD Hypak 換到不同廠商），需要重新評估自由跌落測試結果——因為容器材質和內容物重量會影響衝擊結果。
blocks.en: For a CDMO: if the customer changes the primary packaging of the PFS (for example, from BD Hypak to a different supplier), the free fall test results need to be re-evaluated, because container material and content weight affect the impact outcome.

blocks.zh: 溫度條件說明：2014 年第三版修訂
blocks.en: Temperature Conditions: Revision in the 2014 Third Edition

blocks.zh: 本版重要修訂：循環測試（10.8）的溫度從原本 25°C ± 3°C 改為 5°C ± 3°C。
blocks.en: Key revision in this edition: the temperature for the cycling test (10.8) changed from 25°C ± 3°C to 5°C ± 3°C.

blocks.zh: 理由：冷藏藥品（2–8°C 儲存）的使用者通常在冷藏後直接使用，5°C 更能代表實際最低使用溫度。25°C 過於保守（室溫），無法測試冷藏後的性能。
blocks.en: Rationale: users of refrigerated drug products (stored at 2–8°C) usually use them directly after removal from the refrigerator, so 5°C better represents the actual lowest use temperature. 25°C is too lenient (room temperature) and cannot test performance after refrigeration.

blocks.zh: 如果客戶的 DV 報告是基於舊版（2012 年第二版），此測試條件差異需要特別注意，可能需要補充測試。
blocks.en: If the customer's DV report is based on the old edition (2012 second edition), this difference in test conditions needs special attention and supplementary testing may be required.

blocks.zh: EMC 測試：何時需要？
blocks.en: EMC Testing: When Is It Required?

blocks.zh: EMC 測試（10.10）僅適用於含電子/電機元件的 NIS，包括：
blocks.en: EMC testing (10.10) applies only to NIS containing electronic/electromechanical components, including:

blocks.zh: 電子劑量計算器的筆型注射器
blocks.en: Pen injectors with an electronic dose calculator

blocks.zh: 有電子感應器的自動注射器（感應注射完成）
blocks.en: Autoinjectors with electronic sensors (detecting completion of injection)

blocks.zh: Connectivity pen injector（藍牙配對型）
blocks.en: Connectivity pen injectors (Bluetooth-paired)

blocks.zh: 電驅動大容量穿戴式注射器
blocks.en: Electrically driven large-volume wearable injectors

blocks.zh: 純機械式 autoinjector（D1，無電子元件）不需要 EMC 測試。
blocks.en: A purely mechanical autoinjector (D1, no electronic components) does not require EMC testing.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 某客戶提供 DV 報告，自由跌落測試使用 20 支 D1 autoinjector，結果全部通過視覺檢查和劑量準確性測試。CDMO 審查時發現 n=20（p=0.95，k<sub>tar</sub>=2.760）。如果 k<sub>act</sub> = 2.50，是否應接受此 DV 結果？
blocks.en: A customer provides a DV report in which the free fall test used 20 D1 autoinjectors, and all passed the visual inspection and dose accuracy tests. During review, the CDMO finds n=20 (p=0.95, k<sub>tar</sub>=2.760). If k<sub>act</sub> = 2.50, should this DV result be accepted?

blocks.zh: 客戶計劃更換 autoinjector 的彈簧規格（提高驅動力以適應高黏度新配方）。根據 Table 3，哪些 DV 測試需要重新執行？
blocks.en: The customer plans to change the spring specification of the autoinjector (increasing the driving force to suit a new high-viscosity formulation). According to Table 3, which DV tests need to be repeated?

blocks.zh: 新型 smart pen injector 配有藍牙連接功能，用於記錄注射時間和劑量。根據 Section 10.10，需要額外的哪些 EMC 測試？相關的 IEC 標準是哪些？
blocks.en: A new smart pen injector has Bluetooth connectivity to record injection time and dose. According to Section 10.10, which additional EMC tests are required? Which IEC standards apply?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 測試邏輯：預處理 + DA：大多數測試 = 施加環境壓力 → 恢復標準條件 → 量測劑量準確性；核心驗證 NIS 在真實使用環境後是否維持性能
blocks.en: Test logic: pre-conditioning + DA: most tests = apply environmental stress → return to standard conditions → measure dose accuracy; the core purpose is to verify that the NIS maintains performance after real-world use conditions

blocks.zh: D1 必測項目：溫度（60支，p=0.975）、自由跌落（21支）、乾熱/冷儲（60支）、振動（20支）；壽命週期和潮濕熱僅適用 A/B 系統
blocks.en: Required tests for D1: temperature (60 units, p=0.975), free fall (21 units), dry heat/cold storage (60 units), vibration (20 units); life-cycle and damp heat apply only to A/B systems

blocks.zh: 第三版修訂重點：循環測試溫度從 25°C 改為 5°C（冷藏後使用場景）；EMC 樣本數從 5 支增至 20 支
blocks.en: Key points of the third edition revision: cycling test temperature changed from 25°C to 5°C (use after refrigeration scenario); EMC sample size increased from 5 to 20 units

blocks.zh: EMC 限於電子元件：純機械式 autoinjector 不需 EMC；含感測器、藍牙、電機驅動的 NIS 需 ESD + RF 測試
blocks.en: EMC is limited to electronic components: purely mechanical autoinjectors do not need EMC; NIS with sensors, Bluetooth or electric motor drives need ESD + RF testing
